materials.name: Iron Ore
materials.desc: Rust-streaked rock heavy with iron. The backbone of every smithy.

materials.name: Copper Ore
materials.desc: Green-crusted stone that tingles faintly when struck by lightning.

materials.name: Silver Ore
materials.desc: Pale ore that lycanthropes and fiends instinctively shy away from.

materials.name: Gold Ore
materials.desc: Soft, warm-coloured ore; takes enchantments of majesty and charm well.

materials.name: Mithral Ore
materials.desc: Silvery ore so light it seems to float in the hand. Found in deep veins beneath mountains.

materials.name: Adamantine Ore
materials.desc: Black-green ore that dulls ordinary picks. Often found near meteorite falls and the Underdark.

materials.name: Coal
materials.desc: Black fuel for forges and furnaces.

materials.name: Iron Ingot
materials.desc: A bar of wrought iron, ready for the anvil.

recipe.lore: Ore is smelted with coal to drive out slag.

materials.name: Steel Ingot
materials.desc: Folded, carbon-hardened iron that holds an edge.

recipe.lore: Iron is reheated with charcoal and folded until it takes on carbon.

materials.name: Copper Ingot
materials.desc: A soft reddish bar, excellent for conducting both current and spellwork.

recipe.lore: Copper melts easily over a charcoal fire.

materials.name: Silver Ingot
materials.desc: Refined silver, the bane of werewolves and devils alike.

recipe.lore: Silver ore is cupelled to strip away lead and dross.

materials.name: Gold Ingot
materials.desc: A small, heavy bar of pure gold.

recipe.lore: Gold is melted and poured into a crucible mould.

materials.name: Mithral Ingot
materials.desc: A feather-light bar of true mithral. Armour made from it barely hinders movement.

recipe.lore: Mithral only flows at a white heat that ordinary forges struggle to reach; dwarven bellows help.

materials.name: Adamantine Ingot
materials.desc: An almost unbreakable bar of adamantine that shrugs off blows that would shatter steel.

components.label: Any fire core (to reach the melting point)

recipe.lore: Coal alone cannot melt adamantine; smiths feed their forge with a fire elemental's core or salamander heart.

materials.name: Seasoned Timber
materials.desc: Dry, straight-grained hardwood for hafts, bows and staves.

materials.name: Cured Leather
materials.desc: Tanned, supple hide ready for stitching.

recipe.lore: Any hide can be scraped, salted and tanned into leather — but it loses whatever magic it had. Use the raw hide for magical crafting.

materials.name: Tanning Salts
materials.desc: A pouch of salt, alum and oak-bark tannin used to cure hides.

materials.name: Preserving Salts
materials.desc: Packed around organs, blood or meat, these salts extend a perishable part's life to 1 week.

materials.name: Linen Cloth
materials.desc: A bolt of plain woven linen.

materials.name: Wool Cloth
materials.desc: Warm, felted wool; resists rain and cold.

materials.name: Silk Cloth
materials.desc: Fine silk that takes dyes and enchantments beautifully.

materials.name: Strong Thread
materials.desc: Waxed linen thread for sewing leather and cloth.

materials.name: Glass Vial
materials.desc: A stoppered vial for potions, oils and poisons.

materials.name: Crystal Phial
materials.desc: A cut-crystal phial that holds potent magic without cracking. Needed for rare and stronger potions.

materials.name: Essence Vessel
materials.desc: A rune-etched glass bulb that captures the magical essence escaping a creature within 1 minute of its death. Empty until used.

materials.name: Parchment
materials.desc: A sheet of scraped and dried sheepskin.

materials.name: Fine Vellum
materials.desc: Calfskin vellum, smooth enough to hold spell-script without bleeding.

materials.name: Common Ink
materials.desc: Oak-gall and soot ink.

materials.name: Quicksilver
materials.desc: Liquid metal that alchemists use to bind unlike essences together.

materials.name: Sulfur
materials.desc: Yellow, foul-smelling crystals from volcanic vents.

materials.name: Saltpeter
materials.desc: White crystals scraped from caves; feeds flames.

materials.name: Beeswax
materials.desc: Golden wax for candles, seals and waterproofing.

materials.name: Lamp Oil
materials.desc: Rendered oil that burns steadily.

materials.name: Alchemical Base
materials.desc: Distilled spirit and purified water — the neutral carrier for every potion.

materials.name: Diamond Dust
materials.desc: Crushed diamond; the classic focus for wards and resurrection magic.

materials.name: Pearl
materials.desc: A lustrous pearl from an oyster bed.

materials.name: Arcane Ink
materials.desc: Ink ground with glimmering residue; required to scribe spell scrolls of 1st level and cantrips.
